M03.summary: Christ stands in a blue mantle with an open Gospel book; loss around the head leaves only traces of the halo.
M03.position: In the diagonally left corner after entering the naos.

M02.summary: Mary stands on a platform holding the child Jesus and points toward him; blue and gold garments and identifying inscriptions frame the pair.
M02.position: In the diagonally right corner after entering the naos.

M01.summary: Mary lies on a bier while Christ holds her swaddled soul within a radiant mandorla; apostles, clergy, women, and angels gather around.
M01.position: Above the main doorway just inside the naos.

M07.summary: Mary bends cheek-to-cheek toward the child Jesus; much of both figures and their clothing has been lost.
M07.position: The second panel to the left of the passage from the outer to the inner narthex.

M06.summary: A heavily damaged Mary holds the child and gestures toward him; only part of the Theon monogram survives.
M06.position: Immediately left of the passage from the outer to the inner narthex.

M08.summary: Only part of John's shoulder, chest, long hair, halo, and rough garment survives from an almost entirely lost figure.
M08.position: Immediately right of the passage from the outer to the inner narthex.

M04.summary: Christ faces slightly toward the opposite Marian panel, blessing with one hand and holding a book with the other; asymmetrical features respond to a moving viewer.
M04.position: In the lunette above the doorway from the outer to the inner narthex.

M17.summary: Anna confronts a maid within a domestic setting; damage interrupts the figures and architecture.
M17.position: On the lower-left wall beneath the left inner-narthex dome.

M25.summary: A group of girls carrying lights accompanies Mary toward her Temple presentation.
M25.position: On the front section of the vault at the naos entrance in the inner narthex.

M27.summary: A fragmentary scene shows Mary within the sequence of her Temple upbringing and education.
M27.position: On the rear of the third arch from the left, immediately right of the naos doorway in the inner narthex.

M62.summary: Jesus performs a healing identified by the guide as involving blindness and inability to speak.
M62.position: On the rear-right pendentive of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

M63.summary: Two blind men approach Jesus together, distinguishing the composition from nearby single-person healings.
M63.position: On the rear-left pendentive of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

M64.summary: Jesus reaches toward Peter's ill mother-in-law as she rises from her bed.
M64.position: On the front-left pendentive of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

M67.summary: A fragmentary supplicant approaches Jesus in a second scene identified with healing a leper.
M67.position: On the rear of the arch immediately right of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

M68.summary: Several people approach Christ in a collective healing composition rather than a single named encounter.
M68.position: On the rear wall beneath the right-hand dome of the inner narthex.

M10.summary: The guide identifies a Marian mosaic positioned above the inner-narthex tomb niche.
M10.position: Above the leftmost tomb niche in the inner narthex.

M11.summary: Theodore Metochites kneels in elaborate court dress and offers a model of Chora to the enthroned Christ.
M11.position: Above the doorway from the inner narthex into the naos.

M12.summary: Christ and Mary form an abbreviated Deesis above the kneeling donors Isaakios Komnenos and Maria Palaiologina.
M12.position: On the front wall beneath the right-hand dome of the inner narthex.

M13.summary: Christ occupies the central medallion while rows of ancestors radiate through the segmented dome; Adam and Noah carry distinctive attributes.
M13.position: In the right-hand dome of the inner narthex.

M14.summary: Mary and the child occupy the central medallion, surrounded by radiating generations of ancestors in the dome segments.
M14.position: In the left-hand dome of the inner narthex.

M15.summary: A priest rejects Joachim's offering while an angelic sign and adjacent figures frame his public disappointment.
M15.position: On the rear-left pendentive of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M16.summary: Joachim sits apart among shepherds and animals after leaving home in grief.
M16.position: On the front-right pendentive of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M18.summary: An angel announces Mary's future birth to Anna, who receives the message in a garden-like setting.
M18.position: On the front arch wall of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M19.summary: Anna and Joachim embrace at a city gate after receiving news that their prayers will be answered.
M19.position: On the front face of the arch immediately right of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M20.summary: Anna reclines after childbirth while attendants wash the infant Mary and others prepare the household.
M20.position: On the front wall of the vault between the first and second bays at the far left of the inner narthex.

M21.summary: Anna and Joachim affectionately hold the young Mary within a domestic architectural setting.
M21.position: On the front section of the vault beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M22.summary: Priests bless the young Mary as her parents present her at a table in their home.
M22.position: On the rear section of the vault beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M23.summary: The infant Mary takes seven steps toward Anna while attendants watch the carefully staged movement.
M23.position: On the front face of the second arch from the left in the inner narthex.

M24.summary: The young Mary climbs toward the high priest as her parents and a procession of girls approach the Temple.
M24.position: On the rear section of the vault beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M26.summary: Mary sits within the Temple while an angel brings food; the priest and architectural enclosure identify the sacred setting.
M26.position: On the front of the third arch from the left, immediately right of the naos doorway in the inner narthex.

M28.summary: Zechariah receives rods associated with Mary's prospective guardians; Joseph's rod is selected by a sign.
M28.position: On the rear of the second arch from the left, immediately left of the naos doorway in the inner narthex.

M29.summary: Zechariah entrusts Mary to the older Joseph after the sign of the rods.
M29.position: On the rear wall of the vault beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M30.summary: Joseph leads Mary from the Temple toward his household as the narrative moves from sacred to domestic space.
M30.position: On the rear face of the arch beside the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M31.summary: Mary receives purple wool allotted for making the Temple veil.
M31.position: On the rear wall of the vault left of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

M32.summary: Joseph departs for work while Mary remains with the household and her assigned wool.
M32.position: On the rear wall beneath the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M33.summary: Gabriel approaches Mary with the announcement of Jesus's conception; her spinning materials connect the moment to the preceding Temple-veil episode.
M33.position: On the rear-right pendentive of the leftmost inner-narthex dome.

M65.summary: A woman reaches toward Christ's garment within a crowd, seeking healing without interrupting his movement.
M65.position: On the front-right pendentive of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

M66.summary: A young man extends an impaired arm toward Jesus in a healing encounter watched by others.
M66.position: On the front of the arch immediately right of the right-hand inner-narthex dome.

M34.summary: An angel addresses the sleeping Joseph, followed by the journey of Joseph and the pregnant Mary toward Bethlehem.
M34.position: Above the exit doorway at the far left of the outer narthex.

M40.summary: The Holy Family travels away from Herod's threat, with Mary and the child mounted while Joseph guides the journey.
M40.position: Immediately above the inner side of the current entrance doorway in the outer narthex.

M09.summary: A surviving lower-panel portrait is identified by the guide as Joachim.
M09.position: On the lower panel behind the leftmost arch of the outer narthex.

M35.summary: Mary and Joseph appear before an official and scribes during the enrollment connected with their journey.
M35.position: On the front wall of the far-left outer-narthex vault at the exit.

M37.summary: The Magi approach the enthroned Herod, whose court turns their search for the newborn king into a political confrontation.
M37.position: On the front wall of the second vault from the right in the outer narthex.

M38.summary: Herod consults priests and scribes about the prophesied birthplace while the damaged composition preserves only part of the inquiry.
M38.position: On the front wall of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

M39.summary: A damaged remnant represents the Magi leaving by a different route after being warned not to return to Herod.
M39.position: High in the vault of the current entrance, toward the passage to the Parekklesion.

M41.summary: Herod issues his command to armed soldiers; surviving details include the ruler, attendants, and the movement of troops.
M41.position: On the right wall of the rightmost vault in the outer narthex.

M42.summary: Soldiers attack children as mothers resist and grieve; extensive loss fragments the violent action.
M42.position: On the rear wall of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

M43.summary: Mothers lament the murdered children through bent bodies, raised hands, and tightly held figures.
M43.position: On the rear wall of the second vault from the right in the outer narthex.

M44.summary: Elizabeth carries the young John away from danger as the landscape opens to shelter them.
M44.position: On the rear of the third vault from the right in the outer narthex.

M45.summary: An angel informs Joseph of Herod's death, followed by the Holy Family's return journey.
M45.position: On the rear of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

M46.summary: Mary and Joseph bring the young Jesus toward Jerusalem in a family procession.
M46.position: On the rear wall of the far-left outer-narthex vault.

M47.summary: The young Jesus sits among teachers in the Temple while Mary and Joseph find him after their anxious search.
M47.position: In the far-left vault of the outer narthex.

M48.summary: John identifies Jesus and the baptism is represented through the meeting of the two figures and the river setting.
M48.position: In the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

M49_1.summary: Satan confronts Jesus through successive temptations, including demands for worship and a vision from a high place.
M49_1.position: On the right side of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

M49_2.summary: Satan confronts Jesus through successive temptations, including demands for worship and a vision from a high place.
M49_2.position: On the right side of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

M49_3.summary: Satan confronts Jesus through successive temptations, including demands for worship and a vision from a high place.
M49_3.position: On the right side of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

M49_4.summary: Satan confronts Jesus through successive temptations, including demands for worship and a vision from a high place.
M49_4.position: On the right side of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

M50.summary: A wedding banquet introduces the setting in which the shortage of wine leads to Jesus's first sign in John's Gospel.
M50.position: In the third vault from the left, the bay containing the main outer-narthex entrance.

M54.summary: A sick man approaches Jesus for healing while disciples stand behind him; much of the panel is damaged.
M54.position: At the front of the fourth vault from the left in the outer narthex.

M56.summary: Jesus addresses a long-disabled man beside the pool, with the man's sleeping mat marking his change of condition.
M56.position: At the front-left of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

M57.summary: Jesus heals a man described in the source by the historical diagnosis of dropsy or edema.
M57.position: At the front-right of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

M58.summary: Jesus reaches toward a blind man in a healing scene associated with sight and recognition.
M58.position: On the front-right pendentive of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

M59.summary: A healed man rises and carries the bed that previously carried him.
M59.position: On the front-left pendentive of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

M60.summary: Jesus speaks with a Samaritan woman beside a well, where the vessel and water anchor the conversation.
M60.position: On the rear-left pendentive of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

M61.summary: Zacchaeus looks toward Jesus from a tree while the surrounding crowd marks his separation and eventual welcome.
M61.position: In the vault containing the current outer-narthex entrance.

M05.summary: Mary raises her arms in prayer while the Christ child appears in a medallion at her center; two angels incline toward her.
M05.position: On the inner upper arch of the old main entrance in the outer narthex.

M36.summary: Mary reclines beside the swaddled child in a cave-like setting as Joseph, animals, angels, shepherds, and attendants occupy linked episodes.
M36.position: On the front wall of the second vault from the left in the outer narthex.

M51.summary: Servants handle large vessels as the Cana narrative turns water prepared in jars into wine.
M51.position: On the front-left pendentive of the main-entrance vault in the outer narthex.

M52.summary: Jesus blesses bread as disciples distribute food to a gathered crowd across multiple pendentives.
M52.position: Across the front-right and rear-right pendentives of the main-entrance vault in the outer narthex.

M53.summary: A fragmentary ox and attendants appear in a scene associated with preparation for a feast.
M53.position: On the rear-left pendentive of the main-entrance vault in the outer narthex.

M55.summary: A man brought on a bed encounters Jesus in the Capernaum healing narrative.
M55.position: At the rear-right of the rightmost outer-narthex vault.

F18.summary: Moses turns and covers his face before a burning bush containing an angel and a Marian medallion.
F18.position: On the right side of the north wall in the western Parekklesion bay.

F20.summary: Four men carry a brightly striped, chest-like Ark before a mountain and distant architecture.
F20.position: On the right side of the south wall in the eastern Parekklesion bay.

F22.summary: Crowned Solomon swings a censer before seven elders who approach against a mountainous landscape.
F22.position: On the left side of the south wall in the western Parekklesion bay.

F23.summary: Elders place the Ark on a raised altar beneath seraphim; another group looks upward as divine light fills the Temple.
F23.position: On the right side of the south wall in the western Parekklesion bay.

F03.summary: Jesus approaches a young man sitting upright on a carried bier while his widowed mother and a startled crowd respond.
F03.position: Beside the Anastasis on the lower Parekklesion apse program.

F04.summary: Jesus takes the girl's wrist as she rises on an ornate bed; Jairus, women, and apostles surround the intimate interior.
F04.position: Beside the Anastasis on the lower Parekklesion apse program.

F06.summary: Michael sounds a trumpet toward sea and land as the dead rise from tombs and even from the mouths of sea creatures.
F06.position: On the southwest pendentive of the Parekklesion judgment vault.

F07.summary: A standing angel supports a small praying soul by the head and points toward its destination.
F07.position: On the northwest pendentive of the Parekklesion judgment vault.

F08.summary: Abraham sits enthroned with the small figure of Lazarus in his lap, surrounded by other waiting souls in a garden-like setting.
F08.position: In paired panels on the judgment vault, opposite the rich man's punishment.

F09.summary: A naked rich man sits within flames beside spilled coins and money bags, looking toward Lazarus across the vault.
F09.position: On the southeast pendentive of the Parekklesion judgment vault.

F10.summary: Small demonic figures lead souls into varied punishments beside the fiery stream and the weighing of deeds.
F10.position: Where the river of fire descends from Christ's feet into the Parekklesion judgment vault.

F11.summary: Peter leads groups of women, martyrs, monks, bishops, and prophets toward a seraph-guarded gate; Mary and the repentant thief appear inside.
F11.position: At the gate of paradise within the Parekklesion judgment cycle.

F13.summary: John of Damascus sits at a writing table with pen, ink, and folded hymn text, framed by architecture.
F13.position: On the northeast pendentive beneath the western Parekklesion dome.

F14.summary: Kosmas sits with a notebook and dips his pen into an inkwell, wearing layered blue and green garments.
F14.position: On the southeast pendentive beneath the western Parekklesion dome.

F15.summary: Joseph sits at a low writing station and displays a long scroll associated by the guide with Marian hymnody.
F15.position: On the southwest pendentive beneath the western Parekklesion dome.

F16.summary: Theophanes writes in a notebook from a low seat, with writing equipment arranged before him.
F16.position: On the northwest pendentive beneath the western Parekklesion dome.

F19.summary: Above, Moses faces the burning bush; below, he bends to remove his sandals beside his flock and dog.
F19.position: On the north side of the arch between the eastern and western Parekklesion bays.

F21.summary: Two men carry a seven-branched lampstand and a handled sacred vessel toward the Temple.
F21.position: On the south side of the arch between the eastern and western Parekklesion bays.

F24.summary: Isaiah holds a prophecy scroll while Michael advances with sword and scabbard before Jerusalem and the defeated Assyrian force.
F24.position: On the south side of the western Parekklesion arch.

F25.summary: Aaron and two sons carry offerings toward a stepped altar as a beam descends on the sanctuary.
F25.position: On the north side of the western Parekklesion arch.

F26.summary: The source title and two photographs identify a composition of righteous souls held in a divine hand.
F26.position: Within the Parekklesion; the source does not provide a differentiating sub-location for F26.

F27.summary: A separate source photograph is numbered F27 under the same title as F26, indicating a second or differently framed righteous-souls image.
F27.position: Within the Parekklesion; the source does not provide a differentiating sub-location for F27.

F28.summary: The source title and photograph identify Melchizedek, king and priest of Salem, as an individual sacred figure.
F28.position: Within the Parekklesion; the source does not provide a differentiating sub-location for F28.

F29.summary: The source title and photograph identify an individual image of Jesus Christ separate from the large Anastasis and Last Judgment figures.
F29.position: Within the Parekklesion; the source does not provide a differentiating sub-location for F29.

F30.summary: The source title and photograph identify a portrait of Christ placed on an arch.
F30.position: On an arch within the Parekklesion; the source does not specify which arch or exact face.

F32.summary: A life-size Mary stands on a rectangular platform and presses her cheek tenderly to the child Jesus, who holds a scroll.
F32.position: On the south pier of the bema arch in the Parekklesion.

F01.summary: Church fathers stand in matching white vestments marked with dark and red crosses, each holding a book and blessing.
F01.position: Across the lower apse wall of the Parekklesion, divided by the central window.

F02.summary: Radiant Christ breaks the gates of death, binds Satan, and pulls Adam and Eve from their tombs as kings, prophets, and the righteous witness the act.
F02.position: In the apse semi-dome at the east end of the Parekklesion.

F05.summary: Christ presides over an extensive judgment cycle containing the rolled heavens, Deesis, prepared throne, weighing of souls, resurrection, paradise, and punishment.
F05.position: Across the upper walls and vault adjoining the Anastasis in the Parekklesion.

F12.summary: Mary and the child fill the rainbow-bordered center while twelve standing angels radiate around them; four archangels hold globes.
F12.position: In the central medallion and twelve compartments of the western Parekklesion dome.

F17.summary: Sleeping Jacob sees a ladder carrying angels toward heaven; below, he braces his legs while wrestling an angel.
F17.position: On the left side of the north-wall tympanum in the western Parekklesion bay.

F31.summary: Michael fills a medallion in red, holding a staff and a globe marked with Greek letters while golden wings close behind him.
F31.position: In the central medallion of the broad bema arch separating the apse Anastasis from the Last Judgment vault.
